 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news With the SSA in the midst of October’s three-Wednesdays cycle, check out this month’s Social Security and SSI payment calendar.
 Getty Images U.S. benefits When are Social Security and SSI benefits paid out in October 2026? Complete payment schedule
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Oct 19th, 2026 10:43 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google According to the Social Security Administration’s (SSA) payment schedule , the agency has completed three out of five distribution dates in October , as it issues benefits for the following U.S. programs:
 Social Security ( retirement, disability and survivor ) 
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) 
 October’s three-Wednesdays Social Security cycle: status update
 Of the just over 71.6 million Social Security beneficiaries in the U.S., many get their benefits on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month . These recipients’ payment day is decided by their date of birth.
 In October, this three-Wednesdays cycle kicked off last week, with two distribution dates still pending: 
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, October 14 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, October 21 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, October 28 
 NB: If you claim Social Security based on someone else’s employment history, the SSA refers to the other person’s birthday .
 What other payment dates does the SSA have in October?
 Early in October, the SSA’s benefits schedule featured two payment dates that were not birthday-dependent .
 October 1: SSI recipients 
 B eneficiaries of the SSI program were paid on Thursday, October 1 . A benefit for low-income, low resource individuals who are over the age of 65 or have a disability, SSI is worth a monthly average of $735.86, per the SSA.
 A scheme with 7.3 million recipients, SSI is separate to the Social Security program . Unlike Social Security, whose claimants must earn work credits to qualify, eligibility for SSI does not depend on an applicant’s employment record.
 October 2: Double beneficiaries/certain long-term Social Security recipients 
 On Friday, October 2, the SSA sent out Social Security money to beneficiaries who began receiving their monthly payments before May 1997 . October 2 was also this month’s Social Security distribution date for recipients who claim SSI at the same time .
 The two groups of Social Security recipients above are normally paid 24 hours later, but distribution was brought forward as October 3 was a non-business day .
 How much are Social Security benefits?
 Retirement: $2,034.54 
 Disability: $1,499.41 
 Survivor: $1,636.31 
 ( Average monthly benefit , per the latest figures shared by the SSA .)
 COLA announced: how much is it?
 On October 14, the SSA confirmed that Social Security and SSI benefits will increase by 3.6% from January , in the agency’s latest annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). The largest hike of its kind in four years, the 2027 COLA translates into a monthly increase of around $70 on the current average Social Security payment.
 How does the Social Security Admin pay benefits?
 Benefits can be paid into a Social Security or SSI beneficiary’s bank account by direct deposit 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements
